name: Add sparkle and bits
purpose: Add bounded reusable ingredient batches and optionally choose subtypes.
on_enter: Restore batches and active category; empty inclusions is a valid recipe.
Show four current jars plus previous/next page controls. Sparkle has stars/hearts; beads has pearls/sprinkles; charms has fruit and gem families.
Fruit chooses strawberry/kiwi/orange via a small subtype drawer; gems chooses round/diamond. All nine primitives map to six families.
on_exit: Resolve airborne pieces to saved anchors; stop dispenser sounds and checkpoint batch IDs.
persistence: Store max 6 batches, each with id, familyId, subtype, amount and seedOffset. Amount tokens map to 8/16/24 logical pieces; total maximum 120. Low tier draws a deterministic subset without changing the recipe.
back_rule: Back 05; Next 07 even with no decoration. Undo removes the last batch; category browsing does not mutate recipe.
acceptance: Tap jar then bowl and drag jar to bowl produce one equivalent batch.
Maximum density is readable and cannot create unbounded meshes.
Foam shows projected surface pieces and retains original batch data when switching to gel.
implementation_notes: Use the amount chooser before adding a batch; at cap show a full-bowl symbol and Undo, not failure or paid refill.
A source sprite of six toy previews is not an inclusion material or a saved toy recipe.

actions.trigger: Tap jar or begin assisted drag
actions.guard: Known family/subtype; unlocked or Free Play
actions.command: session.selectedInclusion=family/subtype; open subtype drawer where required
actions.state_write: No recipe write before add accepted.
actions.interrupt: Cancel returns jar; no accidental batch.

actions.trigger: Tap bowl after jar selection or release jar in broad bowl target
actions.guard: Selected usable family; batch count<6; total + amount<=120
actions.command: Commit batch ID/seed once, then animate drop to deterministic anchors
actions.state_write: Append batch; bump revision; reset fill/reveal/photo. Record distinct family tried once.
actions.interrupt: Cancel after logical commit resolves to anchors. Never commit again on animation completion.

actions.command: Set current category and page=0; preserve recipe
actions.interrupt: Locked option opens pictorial requirement only.
